definitions.explanation: A desperate, heartfelt plea or request. Implies begging sincerely and urgently, often from a position of vulnerability or need.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{懇願|こんがん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He begged them to spare his life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懇願|こんがん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mother tearfully implored the doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懇願|こんがん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The residents implored the mayor to stop the construction, but the plan proceeded as scheduled.

notes:
USAGE:
{懇願|こんがん} is a strong word that implies desperate, sincere pleading. It is more intense than ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask) or ⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧ (to request) — it conveys emotional urgency and vulnerability.

Often used in dramatic or literary contexts, but also appears in news reports about serious situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懇願|こんがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to implore, to beg
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懇願|こんがん}: tearful plea
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懇願|こんがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to desperately implore
- {懇願|こんがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き{入|い}れる→聞き入れる：04586_kikiireru⟧: to grant an earnest request

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {懇願|こんがん}: entreaty (desperate, heartfelt pleading)
- ⟦{嘆願|たんがん}→嘆願：21595_tangan⟧: petition, appeal (formal plea, often to authorities)
- ⟦{哀願|あいがん}→哀願：16758_aigan⟧: supplication (pleading pitifully)
- ⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧: request (neutral, formal)
